sections.section_heading: Six tools, six verdicts, and nothing that ships the fix
sections.description:
Your SEO platform does not know whether an answer engine can read the page. Your accessibility scanner does not know which pages carry revenue. Your performance tool grades a lab simulation rather than the site your customers load. Each one is confident, and no two agree on what to fix first.

The findings are saved as a PDF. The fix never reaches the backlog.

sections.section_heading: Five steps, and the loop closes itself
paragraphs: How it works
Twelve lenses run in one pass and return severity-weighted scores, with page-level intelligence on intent, audience and category.
Every diagnosis ships with a proposed patch, a ticket and a confidence score, opened straight against your repo or CMS.
Each issue carries an estimated revenue exposure drawn from your own analytics, so a sprint gets allocated against dollars rather than a hunch.
Per-release scoring and diffs, across geography, device and network, with alerts into Slack or Teams.
Known-safe regressions auto-merge inside the guardrails you set. Everything else queues with a recommendation.

sections.section_heading: It decides what matters, then routes the work
sections.description: The Supervisor is the orchestration layer, not a thirteenth lens. It sequences the twelve module agents by effort, risk and revenue impact, auto-merges patterns you have already approved, queues the rest with a recommendation, and escalates to a named human owner whenever confidence drops below the threshold you set.

paragraphs: A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

A website-intelligence platform from Ladder7 NextStep Solutions. It audits your live site across twelve lenses, including performance, accessibility, SEO, AEO, GEO, AI readiness and security, and unifies the results into a single Digital Health score with fixes ranked by impact.
Real checks against your actual live website, rather than estimates from cached or sampled data, so findings reflect how search engines, auditors and AI systems really read your site.
One number summarising your site's health across all twelve lenses, so teams track a single shared metric over time instead of a dozen disconnected ones.
By impact. Findings are tied to traffic, conversion and revenue through your analytics connectors, so the ranking reflects what moves the numbers rather than the order a checklist happened to run in.
Yes. Name your rivals and they are scored on the same twelve lenses weekly, including share of voice and citation share on AI surfaces.
Only within limits you set. Patterns you have approved can auto-merge; everything else waits for review, every patch is editable, and rollback is one click.
Enter your URL to run a scan, or book a demo for a guided walkthrough on your own site.
